name: Adjacent-Pendant Class
definition: $C_{\mathrm{adj}}=\{0000,0001,0010,0011,0101,1000\}$: a square on the last two coordinates with pendant vertices in the other directions at adjacent square corners.
properties: It is ample and maximum-degree-optimal, as are all of its coordinate fixings, but it is not diameter-optimal. A coordinate projection is the three-leaf star and is not maximum-degree-optimal, so the class is not pc-degree-optimal.
